notes.title: Rusts Beasts And How to Fight Them
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/9e205366f026993227dff916743b7b3255a846b4.png[/img]

Smokestack Mountain is full of dangers, not least of them rust beasts! These annoying creatures will attack you on sight, so you'll have to be on your guards at all times.

[b][h1]Rust Wasps[/h1][/b]Ugh, these guys. They fly around and shoot at you. You wouldn't believe how annoying they can be. While slow themselves, their projectiles will inflict Power Leakage, a rather painful damage over time. Evade the projectile, and shoot them while they reload!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/af15b45b0bcca0c301975f7d53a0a3bef495775f.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Rust Spiders[/h1][/b]These nasty little guys are expert trappers. As far as rust beasts go, don't let them catch you off guard. They may move slowly, but their web will inflict a debuff slowing down your movement for quite a while. Shoot the web out of your way, then dash in and finish them off with your blade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/c6ec7fa6bf54cf5f5807ce0d56b8598768107593.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Rust Dragonflies[/h1][/b]Ah, dragonflies... The way these guys dive-bomb you can be really aggravating. Evade their dash with a jump or a dash of your own, then defeat them with your drill. Or better yet—be fearless and quickly shoot them while they're flying at you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/2133ae83be73215817d9646f576fb33a5c49d40d.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Rust Rhinos[/h1][/b]In Stamp's own words, "not that I have a problem with rushing in headlong, but when a rust beast does it to me, that's a different story..." With Rhinos, patience is key: when they rush at you, the only way to evade is to jump over them. Once their back is exposed, attack them with all you have, preferably with your hammer! Taking them on from the front will only result in heavy damage (for you).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/c65eee5a6681a7771efe3a1882da80f09631f499.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The 4 Weapons of Rusty Rabbit
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/44ebbe07b91df731971aa9f5c69a6b94e71f0b5b.png[/img]

Digging for junk while keeping rust beasts at bay is no small feat, especially when said beasts target avid rust-diggers like Stamp. Luckily, Junkster can be equipped with a variety of weapons that will make your exploration skills and fighting prowess harder, better, faster and stronger. You can freely switch between weapons at any time!

[b][h1]Drill[/h1][/b]Junkster's base weapon, equipped by default. With it, you can drill through basic junk crates blocking your way and damage most enemies. If you hold the attack button, it will keep drilling which allows for continuous damage for a short while—particularly efficient against rust beasts without armor. It will need to cooldown afterwards, so careful not to overheat it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/5ad8094d98cddf6ab4b0973aae50d0a8f15df09c.png[/img]

[b][h1]Blade[/h1][/b]Cables or vines in your way? Look no further—use the blade, it will cut through them with ease. When swinging your blade in combat, you'll be able to chain attacks for heavier damage, and the arc movement can even hit multiple enemies in one swing no matter if they are in front of you, behind, or above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/6f0415cb53d813c83e7cb275023dcb8df3436ba9.png[/img]

[b][h1]Hammer[/h1][/b]The hammer is slower and has a very short range, but it inflicts heavy damage. In combat, it's very efficient against rust beasts sporting even the strongest of armors such as rhinos. Outside of combat, it will allow you to break stone or denser junk blocks, uncovering more dangerous parts of Smokestack Mountain...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/c3cc1e341623d326670a891c282d71ac66420f90.png[/img]

[b][h1]Shotgun[/h1][/b]Flying enemies can be a pain in the ***. Thankfully, the shotgun can take good care of them! Not only does it have good range and projectile dispersion, it can also be fired in any direction, so you could even kill two dragonflies with one bullet. And if you happen to see a distant lever that looks out of reach, well, try to shoot at it...?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/f89ff44e735716b369d072d0041b4e289d19932d.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
To all aspiring rust diggers: we are very happy to announce the Rusty Rabbit demo is now available!

Download the demo and play through the start of Stamp's adventure! Your save data will carry over to the main game, so you don't have to worry about losing your progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/b52f9dc7ccad27de3b5443b28ce821a8dea6dbab.jpg[/img]
In the demo, you'll hop on your trusty mech Junkster and explore the first level of Smokestack Mountain—the Upper Factory—to experience the basics of rust digging. You'll also meet Stamp's allies (?), the BBs. Beware, these cute furry fellows will never stop trying to recruit you, the veteran rust digger, to their gang of misfits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/de92fafeb047b9fbe24ffb849a7d2f665de6e3a9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/65f286f7c1ab26753774ec5949a3167b2f9729ab.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy your first steps in Smokestack Mountain. It's time to dig some rust... let's go!

notes.title: Introducing... the BBs
notes.notes:
The BBs is a gang of "experienced" rust diggers looking to recruit Stamp to their team. What does "BBs" stand for, exactly? No one really knows...

[b][h1]Anna[/h1][/b]A clever and rather straightforward rabbit, leader of the BBs. She always tries to convince Stamp to join the gang, but she respects his decision not to. According to her, "BBs" officially stands for "Blackberry Corps"... but does it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/be3b12495e438d51d17f7bc64510f533f6c6a999.png[/img]
[b][h1]Wrex[/h1][/b]The youngest member of the BBs, possessing an ability to hear the junk's "voice". She's hailed by Anna as a skilled technician with a high talent for drafting blueprints. Her intense passion for junk occasionally leads to irrational behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/890840c8b5d9123a31183d565e1dadb0814795e9.png[/img]
[b][h1]Flemy[/h1][/b]A skilled rust digger and Paul's older brother. He serves as the team's astute explorer, balancing a light-hearted demeanor with a sensible approach to rust digging, occasionally at odd's with Paul's recklessness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/60e17c0644ed77edd12b5dc121d2ff7d45ea6455.png[/img]
[b][h1]Paul[/h1][/b]Flemy's younger brother. He's dubbed a "mood maker" by Anna despite his average skills, showcasing a surprisingly resilient constitution as he consistently narrowly escapes fatal injuries due to his reckless behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/fa48f88bda0fe20b7685998a5649e7ace176531f.png[/img]
[b][h1]Nether[/h1][/b]A cunning and snobbish priest with a soft-spoken demeanor. Sponsoring the BBs, he seeks to advance in society by exposing the falsehoods of the Church teachings while maintaining a small-time crook persona.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/12ce6f997b90f9748de0e95dd3bdcef342846b21.png[/img]
[b][h1]Soma[/h1][/b]A veteran rust digger, known for her prowess in combat and described as the team's protector by Anna. She possesses a commanding presence yet refrains from aggression, often intervening to curb the reckless behavior of Paul and Wrex.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/ec19f4be862f040fe1c2beaa57b0cdb1ac180a08.png[/img]

notes.title: Introducing... the world of Rusty Rabbit
notes.notes:
Humankind abandoned Earth as it entered another ice age. Over time, those who came to hold dominion over the world were rabbits.

After humanity left, the rabbits referred to humans as "giants" and revered the massive ruins left behind as Smokestack Mountain.

[h2][b]Saint Peter[/b][/h2]The one and only Rabbit God from whom all rabbits descend. According to the legend, Peter stood up to the giant McGregor and started the reign of rabbitkind. The rest is a bit of a blur, but that's basically how it all started.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/3369d02fc4bc42bd67d2500712c7076b33f7830e.png[/img]
[h2][b]Smokestack Mountain[/b][/h2]A massive, towering ruin left behind by humankind, Smokestack Mountain is a never-ending source of rust and various pieces of junk. While most rabbits stay away from it, others like Stamp like to explore it to scavenge what they can—they are referred to as "rust diggers" and frowned upon by the Church.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/b52f9dc7ccad27de3b5443b28ce821a8dea6dbab.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Rust Beasts[/b][/h2]Dwelling within Smokestack Mountain, these terrifying creatures protect the piles of junk sitting there. They will not attack those uninterested in junk, but they will be hostile towards rust diggers like Stamp. During your exploration of Smokestack Mountain, you'll face many different kinds of these fearsome foes...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/2a3be2ddd953d9299cc9af31f98b9fc159dd0052.png[/img]
[h2][b]Brass Village[/b][/h2]The village where Stamp lives. It is a quiet place, a little haven of peace right at the foot of Smokestack Mountain, complete with a few shops and a bar. Always cold and covered in snow, it is nonetheless a cozy and charming place, that no one in their right mind would ever want to leave... right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/4461bea79093a9f85f6eeed7d768bdcd3c5886f6.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]D-TAMs[/b][/h2]Ancient information storage devices scattered throughout Smokestack Mountain. One of these records appears to belong to Stamp's estranged daughter, hinting at her peril and revealing hidden truths about the world he once believed in.
To unravel many mysteries and follow his daughter's trail, Stamp will continue his journey into the depths of the ruins...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/7daac63278153957af15cd1cab697d8441a6da66.png[/img]

notes.title: Introducing... Stamp and Junkster
notes.notes:
Meet the main character of our adventure, Stamp, as well as his trusty mech Junkster.

[b][h2]Stamp[/h2][/b]
Stamp is the game's main character, the one controlled by the player. He's a middle-aged rabbit living in Brass Village, a peaceful place inhabited exclusively by rabbits. He spends most of his time digging junk in the nearby Smokestack Mountain, which he then turns into useful objects for his everyday life. Unlike anyone else, Stamp can "hear" the junk, as if it had a voice, or a soul.

He's estranged from his daughter and hopes to find clues as to her disappearance in Smokestack Mountain, although his hopes are not exactly high.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/53880f11f8941089ce2cb813d350ce27d6dfc5f3.png[/img]

[b][h2]Junkster[/h2][/b]
Junkster is Stamp's proudest creation—a biped mecha made for digging and, when the need arises, combat. Stamp can attach a variety of tools and weapons to Junkster's hull and arms, making it stronger and faster.

While Junkster isn't alive [i]per se[/i], Stamp treats it as his faithful companion and is quite inseparable from it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/fcf4ae6e6af8ad5fdfc9cd093fc44e0d0eb2d5db.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Rusty Rabbit Arrives April 17!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641152/bff05e2f6ee65186a18113123b94d127cd812ac9.png[/img]
Cute little bunny? Not a chance!

We're super excited to announce Rusty Rabbit will be available from [b]April 17[/b]!

Rusty Rabbit is a 2.5D side-scrolling action game following the adventures of Stamp, a grumpy middle-aged rabbit estraged from this daughter and spending his days scavenging in Smokestack Mountain.
The game is developed by Nitro Plus, with a scenario from legendary writer Gen Urobuchi.

[previewyoutube=nYSWvI04XtI;full][/previewyoutube]

You'll be able to try the start of the adventure, with your progress carrying over to the full game!
